rules: read LICENSE and source before adoption
record version, hash, license, notices, and classification
do not add dependency before lockfile, SBOM, security, and legal review
prefer process isolation for GPL/AGPL or unclear-license tools when legally acceptable
never copy source from reference projects without an explicit dependency or independent implementation review

quality_gates: malformed input and negative security tests
diff, secret, license, SBOM, and dependency scans
RTL/LTR, keyboard, accessibility, and Arabic mixed-layout check
migration, backup, restore, and clean-install check
local SHA equals remote GitHub SHA and worktree is clean
